prompt:
Much worse now, still in the same clean chunky toy style. Exactly these: the royal blue roofs gone completely, the hall and the wing reduced to standing walls at about two thirds of their height with jagged but simple broken crowns of a few large steps, the little round turret a short blunt stump, and one ring of large blocky rubble pieces around the base, each piece a simple chunky block. Everything else exactly as it is.

Same building, exactly the same camera angle, framing and plain light grey background, same art style and colours. Damage is big simple shapes with clean sharp edges. No fine gravel, no scattered small stones, no cracks, no dirt. No fire, no smoke, no people. Royal blue stays only on the parts that still stand. The building must look strictly worse than before: nothing repaired, nothing cleaner.
